description:
Find the flows a change touches, with the screen, route, components and data files of every step. Use the map whenever a request names a user flow or a product area ("the cancel account flow", "checkout", "onboarding"). Read .better-design/feature-map.json and pass it to read-feature-map before you plan the change, so you edit every screen, component and route the flow touches and nothing else. If the file does not exist, call build-feature-map first.

Pass `flow` ("cancel account"), `feature` ("billing") or `file` (a path you are about to edit) to narrow it. With no query it lists every flow, and the Main Quest when the map has one: each initiative with what serves it, and what serves none.

Before you build a new feature, screen or marketing page, pass its route, file or name in `planned`. When the answer names a Zapier action, API request or MCP tool that already makes it, or says it serves no initiative, tell the user before you build it.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used only for usage analytics; does not change the result.

feature.description: A feature id or part of its name.

file.description: A file path or route; returns every flow that uses it.

flow.description: A flow id or part of its name.

planned.description: Routes, file paths or names of work you are about to build; checks each against what the product already makes and the Main Quest.

name: read-feature-map
title: Read the Feature Map
